name: gad_bitotc
description: Bitcoin-OTC subgraph as a static attributed graph (4,863 nodes, 128 features, 300 anomalies).
notes: See gad_bitcoinotc: static rendering, not GraFlag's dynamic btc_otc. ada_gad and diffgad are deliberately absent from compatible_methods: each refuses to run on a dataset its authors shipped no tuned configuration for, and inventing one would publish a number from hyperparameters nobody chose. Stored as the upstream .mat rather than converted to a PyG .pt at fetch time: the conversion needs torch and torch_geometric, and the manager is a thin orchestration node that carries neither. The .mat methods read this file directly with no conversion at all; a method wanting PyG calls graflag_runner.read_mat inside its own container, where those libraries exist.
